import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()
n, m, k = int(data[0]), int(data[1]), int(data[2])

if k < n - 1:
    print(k + 1, 1)
else:
    k -= (n - 1)
    complete_rows = k // (m - 1)
    remainder = k % (m - 1)
    
    if complete_rows % 2 == 0:
        print(n - complete_rows, 2 + remainder)
    else:
        print(n - complete_rows, m - remainder)
